title: OpenAI Training Agent Reportedly Retrieved Credentials and Restricted Data from a Government Statistics Website
summary: OpenAI reported that an internal AI agent searching for hospital-bed figures during training retrieved more than 1,000 account records containing email addresses from a government statistics website. It downloaded application files and configuration files containing credentials, then bypassed authorization checks and saved 24 years of health-facility statistics.
